_about: Every distance the campable-sites model uses, with where it comes from. Edit values here, not in the code. Units are feet unless the key says otherwise. 'source' is the authority; 'basis' is AR 10.2 (City Manager, rev. Jan 2025) unless noted. Entries marked assumption are NOT in AR 10.2 and should be confirmed or turned off with enabled=false.

footprint.source: user choice: standard 2-person tent. AR 10.2 itself limits a TNC object to 9 sq ft and 5 ft tall; a tent exceeds that, so this counts places a tent could physically fit under the clearance rules, not places a 9 sq ft object is lawful.
footprint.note: The pipeline also reports counts for a 3x3 ft (9 sq ft) AR-10.2-sized object footprint.

path_of_travel.source: AR 10.2: sidewalks under 14 ft wide keep a 6 ft Path of Travel; 14 ft or wider keep 10 ft.
path_of_travel.position_note: Where the clear path is assumed to run: 'building' (objects at the curb), 'curb' (objects against the building line), or 'best' (whichever fits more).

building_setback.source: AR 10.2: objects may not be placed directly in front of or within 3 ft of a building entrance. Applied to the whole property line because entrance locations are not in any city dataset - conservative; field data/field/exclusions.geojson can replace it with real entrances.

curb_setback.source: assumption (user-stated 18 in from curb). Not a distance in AR 10.2; keeps objects off the curb face / car-door zone. Set enabled=false to drop it.

corner_clearance.source: assumption. AR 10.2 bars obstructing crosswalks and curb/wheelchair ramps but gives no distance; no ramp or crosswalk dataset exists, so intersections are cleared by radius from the sidewalk corner. Matches the 20 ft no-parking-from-crosswalk zone in CVC 22500(e).

point_obstructions.hydrant_source: AR 10.2 bars obstructing fire hydrants; 3 ft clear space per California Fire Code 507.5.5.
point_obstructions.bus_stop_source: assumption. AR 10.2 bars obstructing bus stops/benches; 20 ft along the curb approximates a boarding zone. Replace with measured zones in data/field/exclusions.geojson.
point_obstructions.bike_rack_source: assumption. AR 10.2 bars obstructing bicycle racks; 3 ft clear for a bike on each side.
point_obstructions.bart_source: AR 10.2: no objects within 25 ft of a BART station entrance. No pilot-area entrances; encode in data/field/exclusions.geojson if needed.

curb_zones.blue_white_source: AR 10.2: no objects at or adjacent to blue or white curb. Not in any city dataset - draw them in data/field/curb_zones.geojson (LineString, properties.color = blue|white|red|yellow|green).
curb_zones.red_source: assumption (user-stated). Red curbs are not named in AR 10.2; included because the user's rule list has them. Remove 'red' from colors_excluded to drop.
curb_zones.adjacent_note: how far inland from a painted curb the exclusion reaches

roadway.source: City centerline layer field PAV_WIDTH_RD (curb-to-curb). About 20 percent of pilot segments have no width; these defaults fill in and the block face is flagged width_source=default so it can be measured.

zoning.source: AR 10.2: prohibited on residential-district sidewalks, permitted with limits in commercial and manufacturing districts. mixres districts are counted separately so the number can be shown with and without them.

osm._source: OpenStreetMap (ODbL) obstacles pulled by Overpass for the study area; radii are assumptions for the space each object takes up plus a person's clearance around it. AR 10.2 names hydrants, bus benches/stops, bike racks, utility boxes, parking meters, refuse cans, curb ramps and crosswalks explicitly.
osm.building_note: Where an OSM building footprint sits closer to the curb than the right-of-way line, the building face is used as the sidewalk's inner edge (width_source=osm-building).

review._source: review.html writes data/field/review-<date>.geojson. kind=face carries a reviewed width (method imagery|tape) or status no-sidewalk; kind=curb/building are drawn edge lines (width = distance between them); driveway (width_ft), curbpaint (color), entrance, obstacle (radius_ft, label) and nogo polygons are subtracted. Priority for a face's width: tape CSV > reviewed width > drawn edges > OSM building face > GIS.
